name: COFFE
description: COFFE is a code generation benchmark designed to evaluate the time efficiency of LLM-generated code solutions. It contains function-level and file-level problems with novel stressful test cases and introduces efficient@k metric based on CPU instruction count for stable time efficiency comparison.
reputation: A very recent benchmark from the paper introducing efficient@k, so it is not yet widely adopted but is notable as an emerging code-efficiency evaluation suite.
notes: Focuses on time efficiency rather than correctness; uses CPU instruction count for stable evaluation.
